useCase.title: GitLab MLOps Automation
useCase.description: DevOps and ML teams spend 80-90% of their time on manual pipeline work: code review, CI/CD failures, model deployment, and data validation. We built an AI MLOps platform that orchestrates GitLab projects, automates code review and security scanning, analyzes pipeline failures and auto-remediates, deploys models with drift detection, validates data pipelines for compliance, and optimizes cloud costs. The system uses custom MCP servers (similar to healthcare's twilio_hipaa, assemblyai, nexhealth) that wrap GitLab, MLflow, AWS, Snowflake, and other APIs to provide full MLOps capabilities.
capabilities: GitLab orchestration: project creation, MR routing, pipeline monitoring, release planning, issue triage, milestone management
Code intelligence: automated code review, security scanning, architecture analysis, performance regression detection, auto-fix trivial issues
CI/CD intelligence: predictive failure analysis, root cause analysis, auto-remediation, pipeline optimization, intelligent retry
MLOps automation: model deployment, drift detection, automated retraining, A/B test orchestration, model versioning
Data pipeline management: schema validation, PII detection, compliance checks (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA), lineage tracking
Resource optimization: auto-scaling, environment shutdown, right-sizing, cost anomaly detection
Collaboration intelligence: sprint planning automation, blocker detection, team health tracking

architecture.description: An AI agent orchestrates seven custom MCP servers that wrap real APIs (GitLab REST/GraphQL, MLflow, SonarQube, CodeQL, AWS, Snowflake, Kubecost). Each server exposes domain-specific tools: GitLab Orchestrator for projects/MRs/pipelines; Code Intelligence for review and security; CI/CD Intelligence for failure analysis and auto-remediation; MLOps Automation for deployment and drift; Data Pipeline for validation and compliance; Resource Optimization for cost and scaling; Collaboration for sprints and blockers. The agent receives task inputs (e.g. MR ID, pipeline logs, model ID), calls the appropriate tools, and returns structured outputs.

components.name: GitLab Orchestrator Server
components.description: Wraps GitLab REST and GraphQL APIs for project management, MRs, pipelines, issues, releases.
components.details: Tools: create_project, create_merge_request, assign_reviewers, get_pipeline_status, create_release, create_issue, create_milestone. Handles project structure, CI/CD templates, MR routing by code ownership.
explanation: Single place for all GitLab operations
Enables MR routing, pipeline orchestration, release coordination

components.name: Code Intelligence Server
components.description: Automated code review, security scanning, architecture analysis via GitLab Diff, SonarQube, CodeQL.
components.details: Tools: review_code, scan_security, analyze_architecture, check_performance, auto_fix_trivial, assign_reviewers. AST parsing, vulnerability detection, pattern enforcement.
explanation: Catches bugs and security issues before merge

components.name: CI/CD Intelligence Server
components.description: Pipeline failure analysis, root cause parsing, auto-remediation, optimization suggestions.
components.details: Tools: predict_failures, analyze_root_cause, auto_remediate, optimize_pipeline, fingerprint_failures. Integrates GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud APIs.
explanation: Resolves common failures without human intervention

components.name: MLOps Automation Server
components.description: Model deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, A/B testing, versioning.
components.details: Tools: deploy_model, monitor_model, trigger_retraining, intelligent_rollback, orchestrate_ab_test, version_model. Integrates MLflow, W&B, Prometheus, Feast.

components.name: Data Pipeline Server
components.description: Data validation, schema checks, PII detection, compliance monitoring, lineage tracking.
components.details: Tools: validate_data, version_data, track_lineage, detect_pii, check_compliance, heal_pipeline. Integrates Snowflake, BigQuery, Great Expectations.
explanation: Prevents bad data and compliance violations

components.name: Resource Optimization Server
components.description: Auto-scaling, environment shutdown, right-sizing, cost anomaly detection.
components.details: Tools: auto_scale, shutdown_environments, right_size_resources, detect_cost_anomalies. Integrates AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubecost.

components.name: Collaboration Intelligence Server
components.description: Sprint planning, blocker detection, burndown prediction, retrospective generation.
components.details: Tools: plan_sprint, detect_blockers, predict_burndown, generate_retrospective. Integrates GitLab Issues/Milestones, Slack/Discord.
explanation: Surfaces blockers before they delay sprints

flow.description: Agent receives task (e.g. MR ID, pipeline ID, model ID, data pipeline config).
flow.details: Input format varies by category; agent determines which server(s) to call.

flow.description: Agent selects tools from one or more MCP servers and executes in sequence.
Each server calls underlying APIs (GitLab, MLflow, AWS, etc.) and returns structured results.
flow.details: Servers handle auth, retries, error handling; agent sees tool outputs.

flow.description: Agent combines tool outputs into a coherent response.
flow.details: May include security issues, fix actions, deployment status, compliance flags.

flow.description: Agent returns structured output; may create MR comments, retry pipelines, deploy models.
flow.details: Evaluator validates output schema and correctness of actions taken.

requirements: Custom MCP servers for GitLab, Code Intelligence, CI/CD, MLOps, Data Pipeline, Resource Optimization, Collaboration
API access: GitLab, MLflow, SonarQube/CodeQL, AWS/GCP/Azure, Snowflake/BigQuery
Staging environment with GitLab project, pipeline, and sample model
